questions.question: What file format does finance's import tool expect?

options.label: Semicolon-separated
options.adds: Finance's import tool expects semicolon-separated values.

options.label: Comma-separated
options.adds: Finance's import tool expects comma-separated values with ISO dates.

options.label: Tab-separated
options.adds: Finance's import tool expects tab-separated values.

rewriteBeforeAnswers: Make the CSV export work with finance's import tool. Finance imports our CSV exports into their accounting tool every month, so the export has to match what that import accepts. Done when the export output matches that expectation and you report what you changed.
